title: Hydraulic Pressure — Minor Drift
description: Hydraulic pressure P050 = {val} bar. Drifted {val2} bar below nominal setpoint over last 24 hours.
probable_cause: Minor internal leakage or relief valve creep.
remedy: Adjust relief valve if within range. Log and monitor.
required_action: Log fault. Schedule maintenance within 24 hours. Reduce feed rate by 20%.
escalation_path: If HYD-MD-001 is not addressed (log fault. schedule maintenance within 24 hours. reduce feed rate by 20%.), the fault will escalate in this order: HYD-MJ-001. Each subsequent code represents a more severe fault state requiring more urgent intervention. Query each related code for its specific thresholds and required actions.
